tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Current monthly PickTrack chart for one genre: the Top 3 tracks with artist, BPM, Camelot key, release date and SoundCloud link, plus the BPM/key of the next locked ranks and a link to the full chart.

tools.name: get_charts_overview
tools.description: The current #1 track of every PickTrack genre chart (16 genres) with BPM, Camelot key and links.

tools.name: find_track
tools.description: Look up a track or artist in this month's PickTrack charts: which genre chart it is in, its rank, BPM and Camelot key.

tools.name: find_compatible_tracks
tools.description: Chart tracks that mix harmonically with a given Camelot key (same key, ±1 on the wheel, or relative major/minor) and a similar BPM — for building a DJ set.
